prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: pixel-art NPC speech-mouth sprite sheet.
Primary request: Create one 3×3 atlas of this same character's lower-face crops for the happy emotion. Make the lips read as the source character's warm, gentle smile, clearly happier than neutral without a giant grin. Keep all nine mouth poses faithful to their Rhubarb phoneme definitions while retaining a subtle happy mouth-corner expression.
Input image: The single supplied image is the exact local mouth reference grid. It repeats the original lower halves as layout and identity reference.
Style/medium: Soft, muted, low-resolution pixel art. Preserve the source's natural pink lips, warm skin, brown hair, blue clothing edges, softened native pixel clusters, and low-contrast palette.
Composition/framing: Output exactly a 3×3 grid, overall aspect ratio 64:29. Each cell is the same complete lower-face crop as one reference cell. Row-major order A B C / D E F / G H X. No labels, text, gutters, borders, extra panels, full-face views, or zoomed feature crops.
Constraints: Keep original identity, nose, jaw, neck, hair, background registration, lip scale, and lip center. Teeth, only where each pose requires them, use muted neutral ivory-gray distinct from skin; keep them subdued, never bright shiny white. Use modest cavity contrast. Preserve each phoneme shape; happy expression changes corners and tension without replacing the requested pose.
Rhubarb mouth-shape definitions:
A: pressured closed lips with light pressure for P/B/M.
B: slightly open, nearly together teeth; narrow horizontal opening for most consonants and EE.
C: medium open mouth with relaxed unrounded lips for EH/AE.
D: wide vertical opening for AA, larger opening than C.
E: slightly rounded lips, opening no wider than C for AO/ER.
F: puckered rounded lips, small forward opening, not a tooth bite, for UW/OW/W.
G: upper teeth touch the lower lip, not a wide open vowel, for F/V.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth, opening between C and D, for long L; tongue may be invisible at native scale.
X: relaxed closed idle lips.
Avoid: Huge grin, exaggerated corners, lipstick-red lips, bright white teeth, warm skin-colored teeth, tooth gaps, shiny teeth, missing phoneme distinctions, stretched jaw, enlarged face features, blur, gradients, vector shapes, labels, gutters, or changed background.
